summary_md: **Qwen AI Fans ([@QwenAIFans](https://x.com/QwenAIFans/status/2116723275682443758))** shares **Neuron Studio**, which runs Qwen3.5-4B in the browser and lets you steer chosen neurons by layer and strength, comparing original and steered outputs side by side with no server ([webml-community/neuron-studio](https://huggingface.co/spaces/webml-community/neuron-studio)).
